column23: Any site like this is designed so that upvoted content is seen by a much larger number of people than down voted content (which is, after all, pretty much the point). So you're going to get a lot more upvotes than downvotes, making rampant upvoting still strategically sound. You could weight negative positions more than positive ones, or you could also have a buy in cost. Buy in cost does provide a disincentive to voting which probably isn't desirable.
